## Model results

### Functions

```{r}
source("analysis/03_functional_regression/elasticnet_functions.R")
```

### Inputs

```{r}
name_binding   <- "vaa_iaa_binding"
name_condition <- "vaa_iaa"

brain_csv   <- "data/03_functional_regression/meg_action_difference.csv"
binding_csv <- "data/03_functional_regression/perceptual_shift_difference.csv"

out_filtered_csv <- "results/03_functional_regression/action_binding.csv"
```

### Settings

```{r}
time_lower_ms <- 0
time_upper_ms <- 1000
time_windows_ms <- c(10, 20, 40)

alpha_grid <- seq(0.1, 1.0, by = 0.1)

n_lambda <- 100
intercepts <- c(TRUE, FALSE)
```

### Run

```{r}
brain_long <- read_csv(
  brain_csv,
  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
) %>%
  filter(condition == name_condition) %>%
  mutate(region = make_region_label(region))

binding_df <- read_csv(
  binding_csv,
  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
) %>%
  select(subject, all_of(name_binding))

feature_df <- prep_brain_features(
  brain_long = brain_long,
  time_windows_ms = time_windows_ms,
  time_lower_ms = time_lower_ms,
  time_upper_ms = time_upper_ms
)

regions <- sort(unique(feature_df$region))

all_models <- run_elasticnet_grid(
  feature_df = feature_df,
  binding_df = binding_df,
  regions = regions,
  time_windows_ms = time_windows_ms,
  alpha_grid = alpha_grid,
  intercepts = intercepts,
  binding_col = name_binding,
  n_lambda = n_lambda
)

conti_p_list <- list(
  "AG-R"      = list("10" = 3, "20" = 3, "40" = 3),
  "DLPFC-R"  = list("10" = 4, "20" = 5, "40" = 3),
  "Insula-R" = list("10" = 3, "20" = 3, "40" = 3),
  "SMA-R"    = list("10" = 9, "20" = 4, "40" = 3),
  "PreSMA-R" = list("10" = 6, "20" = 5, "40" = 3),
  "PreSMA-L" = list("10" = 9, "20" = 5, "40" = 3)
)

filtered_models <- filter_elasticnet_by_consecutive(
  all_models_df = all_models,
  conti_p_list = conti_p_list,
  time_lower_ms = time_lower_ms,
  time_upper_ms = time_upper_ms,
  consecutive_mode = "strict"
)

filtered_models_final <- post_filter_sparse_and_overlap_run(
  filtered_models = filtered_models,
  time_windows = c(10, 20, 40),
  max_window_ms = 240,
  min_overlap_run_ms = 50,
  allowed_gap_bins = 2
) %>%
  mutate(
    coef = pmap_dbl(
      list(coef, time_window),
      function(x, y) x / (as.numeric(y) / 10)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(region, time_window, lower, upper, coef)

unique(filtered_models_final$region)
```

### Save

```{r}
write_csv(filtered_models_final, out_filtered_csv)

cat("Saved:\n", out_filtered_csv, "\n")
```

## Plot

### Functions

```{r}
source("analysis/03_functional_regression/fun_plot_functional_regression.R")
```

### Inputs

```{r}
out_pdf_split <- "figures/03_functional_regression/action_binding.pdf"

meg_mean_name <- "data/03_functional_regression/plot_data/meg_mean_action.csv"
coef_csv      <- "results/03_functional_regression/action_binding.csv"

regions_name <- c("SMA-R", "PreSMA-R", "PreSMA-L")

border_df <- tibble(
  region = c("SMA-R", "PreSMA-R", "PreSMA-L"),
  xmin   = c(180, 190, 200),
  xmax   = c(260, 250, 290)
)

condition_order <- c("vaa_ba", "iaa_bi", "vaa_iaa")

smooth_span <- c(
  "SMA-R"    = 0.75,
  "PreSMA-R" = 0.40,
  "PreSMA-L" = 0.75
)

style <- list(
  overlap_fill = c(
    "1" = "grey94",
    "2" = "grey88",
    "3" = "grey73"
  ),
  line_colors = c(
    "vaa_ba"  = "#1F86D1",
    "iaa_bi"  = "#FF9A2F",
    "vaa_iaa" = "#ff4d6d"
  ),
  line_lty = c(
    "vaa_ba"  = 5,
    "iaa_bi"  = 5,
    "vaa_iaa" = 1
  ),
  line_labels = c(
    "vaa_ba"  = "Voluntary",
    "iaa_bi"  = "Involuntary",
    "vaa_iaa" = "Difference"
  ),
  coef_shapes = c(
    "10" = 15,
    "20" = 16,
    "40" = 17
  ),
  coef_point_color = "grey50",
  smooth_color = "#9b5de5"
)
```

### Run

```{r}
df_meg_mean_raw <- read_csv(
  meg_mean_name,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
)

coef_df_raw <- read_csv(
  coef_csv,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
)

final_plot <- plot_binding_by_columns(
  df_meg_mean_raw = df_meg_mean_raw,
  coef_df_raw = coef_df_raw,
  regions_name = regions_name,
  border_df = border_df,
  condition_order = condition_order,
  style = style,
  smooth_span = smooth_span,
  time_min = 0,
  time_max = 1000,
  overlap_step_ms = 10,
  reverse_amp_y = TRUE,
  reverse_coef_y = TRUE
)

final_plot
```

### Save

```{r}
ggsave(
  out_pdf_split,
  plot = final_plot,
  width = 8.8,
  height = 8.4,
  units = "in",
  device = cairo_pdf,
  family = "Arial"
)

cat("Saved:\n", out_pdf_split, "\n")
```
